name: M-VAVE FM-1 (Skiff firmware)

channel.note: MENU > MIDI: MIDI IN = CH1-6 (channels 1..6 play tracks 1..6; other channels are ignored entirely) or SEL (every channel plays the selected track); T1..T6 CHANNEL 1..16 per track (default 1..6). USB MIDI in/out and TRS in.

programChange.note: Skiff 1.3+: a PC on a track's channel loads that track's engine's factory sound number n, counted from 0 (0 on an FM6 track = TINE EP); a program past the engine's last preset is ignored, not wrapped; user sounds are not reachable. No bank select (CC 0 / CC 32 ignored). The number means a different sound per engine, so name presets per engine in the rig profile.

controllers.name: Engine brightness (cutoff / DCW / tone / FM6 modulator level)

setup: Load Skiff (web installer); MENU > MIDI: MIDI IN = CH1-6 and the track channels, or SEL.
Program numbers count the track's engine's factory presets from 0: set each track's engine first.
A PC is applied by the main loop after the message: keep a small gap before the notes (no published figure).
notes: 148 factory sounds over 14 engines (per-engine order in firmware/src/engines.c); no complete published name list, so presets are named in the rig profile.
